topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out the building is going condo. Can you believe it? All this time, paying my rent on time, abiding by the rules, and now this. Suddenly, it's all about who can fork over the most cash to keep a roof over their head. What a brilliant move, disrupting the peace, pushing out the regulars. I suppose we should all be grateful for the chance to buy, right? As if that's even an option. It's just another day in the city, I guess, where home is just a transaction waiting to happen.
